name: ripio-community-mcp
description: Read your Ripio account from Claude: balances, activity, prices, limits, open orders and deposit addresses. Unofficial and read-only.
long_description: Unofficial, community-built MCP server for Ripio. Not affiliated with Ripio. It uses your own Ripio API key (create a read-only key in Ripio > Profile > API), runs on your computer and can only send read (GET) requests to api.ripio.com.

tools.name: ripio_get_portfolio
tools.description: Balances across Wallet, memecoins and Ripio Trade with estimated ARS/USD value.

tools.name: ripio_list_activity
tools.description: Wallet movements or Ripio Trade statement, normalized and paginated.

tools.name: ripio_get_transaction
tools.description: Detail of one Wallet movement by id.

tools.name: ripio_get_prices
tools.description: App buy/sell rates and Ripio Trade prices for the requested assets.

tools.name: ripio_estimate_trade
tools.description: Estimated cost or proceeds of a market order, fees included. Nothing is executed.

tools.name: ripio_get_limits
tools.description: Remaining deposit, withdrawal and swap limits per rail.

tools.name: ripio_get_deposit_address
tools.description: Wallet crypto deposit address for an asset and network, with memo and safety warnings.

tools.name: ripio_verify_deposit_address
tools.description: Checks by code that an address is exactly one of your Wallet deposit addresses.

tools.name: ripio_get_deposit_accounts
tools.description: Ripio bank-deposit accounts for fiat (CVU and alias).

api_key.title: Ripio API key
api_key.description: Create a read-only key in Ripio > Profile > API.

api_secret.title: Ripio secret key
api_secret.description: Shown once when you create the key.

trade_rps.title: Ripio Trade requests per second
trade_rps.description: 1 by default; up to 3.5 if your Ripio account has verified documents.
